meta.title: Konten
meta.description: Konten als eigenes DSH-Plugin: ein Sidebar-Eintrag, ein main-Panel mit Benutzerliste (Rolle, Zustand) und Einladungen mit Ablauf. Die Wege liegen in @prometheus-harness/auth-http (/api/pmh/auth/benutzer, /api/pmh/auth/einladungen).

konten.title: Accounts
konten.error: The administration could not be read.
konten.notAdminHint: Sign in with an administrator account — users and invitations will appear here.
konten.chooseAdminHint: Choose which one you act as. The host token proves that you sit at this machine — whom you represent is your decision. The choice is recorded in the audit trail.
konten.usersHint: Every account has its own workspaces, chats, notes, keys and secrets. The separation hangs on the user id — not on this panel.
konten.name: Name
konten.passwordLinkHint: The link works once and expires in 15 minutes.
konten.invitationsHint: A link that expires. Whoever opens it creates their own account and chooses their own password — nobody else sees it. Each link works exactly once.
